title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 296 (Tap-to-Edit Bill No, Sequence Reset Fix & Desktop Auth Prefill)
highlights: Tap-to-Edit Bill Number on Mobile: Users can now tap directly on the Bill No on mobile to correct or customize invoice numbers (e.g. change 005354 to 000535).
Invoice Settings Counter Fix: Setting the next bill number in Settings > Invoice Settings now strictly respects the owner's choice and will not revert back to older high numbers.
Deleted Invoices Ignored: Deleting an accidental or misnumbered invoice completely removes it from the sequence so it never blocks the sequence counter.
Default Admin Auto-Prefill: Username field is automatically pre-filled with 'admin' so customers never wonder what their username is.
1-Click Continue as Admin: When App Lock is turned OFF in Settings, a single tap on 'Continue as Admin' opens the software without demanding any password.
Smart Desktop Logout Alert: Clicking Logout while App Lock is OFF prompts to Close App or Switch User, preventing accidental logout lockouts.
fixes: Added _showEditInvoiceNumberDialog with live duplicate validation to mobile sales screen.
Filtered out deleted sales in _highestSavedInvoiceNumber to prevent sequence lockouts.
Prioritized stored sequence counter in getNextInvoiceNumber to honor manual setting changes.
Pre-filled default admin username on Desktop LoginScreen and added helpful indicator.
Allowed fast-track admin login when App Lock / Startup Password is disabled in Settings.
Added Exit confirmation dialog when logging out with disabled App Lock on Windows desktop.
Synchronized release metadata across Windows and Android to Build 296.
